name: BQ AquaShield External Membrane
description: BQ AquaShield External Membrane is a torched-on SBS modified bitumen sheet membrane system for external waterproofing of balconies, podiums, planter boxes and below-slab applications. Compliant with AS 4654.2 for external waterproofing. Installed with AquaShield Primer and detail tape at laps and penetrations.

components.name: BQ AquaShield Waterproofing Primer 4L
components.description: Water-based penetrating primer for BQ AquaShield wet area and external membrane systems. Consolidates and seals porous substrates including concrete, fibre cement and masonry. Required coat prior to all AquaShield membrane applications.

components.name: BQ AquaShield Self-Adhesive Detail Tape 150mm x 50m
components.description: Self-adhesive bituminous detail tape for sealing laps, penetrations and terminations in BQ AquaShield External Membrane System. 150mm wide, 1.5mm thick. No primer required on membrane surface.
